heading: INT. VANTAGE ARENA - BACKSTAGE GAMING PIT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. VANTAGE ARENA - BACKSTAGE GAMING PIT - NIGHT
Humming.
A hundred fans cooling a hundred machines.
Somewhere beyond the curtain the crowd roars at nothing, at a screen, at a score.

JUNO KESSLER, 20s, headset around her neck, sits alone at Station 9 while the finals lobby loads, and behind her, in the half dark by the cable trunks, a figure in a gray hoodie stands very still with his face turned away, and she has not noticed him, and the monitors all glow the same dead blue.
The loading bar crawls.
Nobody's supposed to be back here.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: I know.
units.name: HOODIE GUY

units.text: The bar does not move.
Her headset crackles at her collar, a whisper under the static, a voice that is not a teammate's.
Coach? Dev? You hear that?
units.name: JUNO

units.text: Nothing.
Then, very faintly, from somewhere behind the curtain, the crowd goes silent.
All at once.
Like a hand over a mouth.
Dev Aranda, 30s, the team coach, pushes through the curtain with a lanyard and a clipboard and stops.
He looks at the hoodie.
He looks at Juno.
The lights above the pit flicker one row at a time, front to back, toward them.
Juno. Walk to me. Don't look at the screen.
units.name: DEV

units.text: It's, it's on my screen, Dev.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: On every monitor in the pit, in the lobby chat, one line types itself out letter by letter, slow as breathing.
We found you.
units.name: THE TWINS

units.text: Juno turns.
At the far end of the pit, two identical kids in tournament jerseys stand shoulder to shoulder, too still, mouths barely moving, and neither of them is breathing.
That's not who you think they are.
units.name: HOODIE GUY

units.text: Get out get out get out
units.name: DEV

units.text: They're not on the roster
units.name: ^JUNO

units.text: Every monitor cuts to black.
The fans die.

In the silence the only sound is something wet and slow dragging across the concrete behind the curtain, and then the curtain moves, and the lights come back all at once, white, blinding, and the pit is empty but for three headsets still warm on the desks, and a lobby chat that reads:
SUPER: "PLAYER 4 HAS JOINED."
